blocks.text: One can see that time is fading away into the hour of the greatest darkness that the earth will be entering into. So many events are taking place. First the financial crisis involving Greece. While they think they have that solved we see Spain, Portugal and Italy now coming to the forefront with their problems. I have been studying some of the older writings of Brother Frisby and remember some of the words he spoke to me, that the end would come as a flood of events on a world unaware of the soon return of Christ, for truly they are asleep as the Scripture said in Matt. 25: 5,6. The early writings and scrolls are pointing to the very events happening now. I have an important message from Brother Neal Frisby’s earliest library.

“This is a very special letter to my wonderful partners and to you personally.” Jesus is definitely going to visit His last golden candlestick (Rev. 1:20) in a very incredible and absolute amazing way at the end time! And you are right in the midst of His overshadowing presence, like the spreading of the sun over the “wheat harvest!” (Bride) Also His electrifying anointing will protect and guide you in His perfect will. He is going to stand firm with you. The sweet influence of the Holy Spirit will bring a great refreshing to those that He has called! Rejoice, just open up and receive! The Lord foreknew us before the foundation of the world and knew both of us would be working together at the appointed time in His work! You are predestined to be involved with some of the greatest miracles and occurrences on the face of the earth! I might say the Lord knows us as well as He knows His greatest archangel! (Eph. 1:4) I would like to repeat something I wrote awhile back. “From what I see ahead, the Lord will really be gathering His children and in such a way the world and foolish virgins will not be able to understand it! The real rich powerful Organizations will wind up with much of the wealth, and in wonder and amazement it will literally be the little children of God that they will push out for disagreeing with them as the churches edge closer to the anti-Christ system!” And the real Bride of the Lord will warn them, but the churches will turn out the true Elect! But Jesus will love those who turn unto Him as He gathers His Elect! A final repudiation of the Word by the World Church system will take place! This age ends in a blackout of the Word, which causes a departure of the Lord from their midst! He will be on the outside calling His children in obedience to His Word.” After a short and powerful demonstration of His spirit the smaller group will be raptured! Remember it was Israel in the old days that had the light, but it was Egypt that was so dark that one could feel it! But in the homes of the Israelites there was light, and that true bright light is coming! The glowing word of the scrolls will break forth in brightness! And Jesus will manifest himself among the people and the pillar of fire will give light to the night! The fullness will rest upon the Saints before long! “Behold saith the Lord, I will be unto her a wall of fire round about, and will be a great glory in the midst of her! I led the children of Israel step by step. Although they wandered for forty years, suddenly and quickly I took them into the Promised Land and at the appointed time I will hurriedly take in My Bride! Yea I will lead ye also. Behold even as I led Elijah the prophet and cared for him, I will care for you! Yea even as I prospered and blessed Abraham and Joseph I will prosper thee according to thy trust, saith the Lord of Host! My hand is not short concerning these promises. Leap forward, saith the Almighty, and I will act quicker than the arrow, which is shot from the bow! My eye hath already seen all that thy soul hath done, and I have not and I shall not overlook even the smallest thing that thou shalt do! Yea, ye have seen many things before but thou hast never seen the likes of this that I am about to do for thee in this hour! Blessed is the man that trusteth in the Lord, for the same hand that wrote in the rock stone for Moses has written the word of this utterance! For I am the Lord and My host is many!” AMEN. (End quote.) – This message has certainly been a blessing and has helped many of Brother Frisby’s partners to understand and trust the full and true word of God. He intended this for the early workers and especially for the late hour workers.

This month I am releasing a New Special Writing Book, Volume Eleven, called “The Final Chapters of Prophecy.” This is certainly an exciting book that I know you will enjoy. Also a DVD called “Digging and Planting” (see offer below.) – This summer we will be witnessing to many people with Brother Frisby’s message with a great amount of his literature. Your help will definitely be needed to accomplish this project. Jesus truly has a reward for our effort in supplying this gospel to those in need. May a special blessing be with all who help this month. I’ll be remembering you in a special prayer. Your Brother in Christ,
